snippet.title: Morbid Metal - Gameplay Trailer - PC Gaming Show
snippet.description:
Morbid Metal available in Early Access on August 20th, 2025.
Play the Demo today!

🔥 Wishlist now on Steam and be the first to take on the challenge:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/

About Morbid Metal:
Morbid Metal is a roguelite hack'n slash game in which you battle fearsome enemies in a dark sci-fi universe. Instantly switch characters to take advantage of their unique characteristics and perform devastating combos. Every victory makes you stronger, every defeat is an opportunity to progress.

Developed by Screenjuice in Unity and published by Ubisoft.
🔻 Follow the game for updates and exclusive content! 🔻
📌X: https://x.com/MorbidMetalGame
📌 BlueSky: https://web-cdn.bsky.app/profile/screen-juice.com
📌 Discord: https://t.co/iUhDCDVTyf
#Ubisoft #MorbidMetal 

About Ubisoft:
Ubisoft is a creator of worlds, committed to enriching players’ lives with original and memorable entertainment experiences. Ubisoft’s global teams create and develop a deep and diverse portfolio of games, featuring brands such as Assassin’s Creed®, Brawlhalla®, For Honor®, Far Cry®, Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon®, Just Dance®, Rabbids®, Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six®, The Crew® and Tom Clancy’s The Division®. Through Ubisoft Connect, players can enjoy an ecosystem of services to enhance their gaming experience, get rewards and connect with friends across platforms. With Ubisoft+, the subscription service, they can access a growing catalog of more than 100 Ubisoft games and DLC. For the 2023-24 fiscal year, Ubisoft generated net bookings of €2.32 billion. To learn more, please visit: www.ubisoftgroup.com.
